skills.name: Resume Tailor
skills.description: Matches your resume to a job posting: fit table, before/after bullet rewrites, and an ATS format check.
skills.try_prompt: Tailor my resume to this job.

skills.name: Cover Letter Writer
skills.description: A specific 250–350 word letter built from your two strongest stories, without the generic phrases.
skills.try_prompt: Write a cover letter for this job using my resume.

skills.name: Interview Prep Coach
skills.description: Likely questions, a STAR story bank, and mock interviews one question at a time with feedback.
skills.try_prompt: Run a mock behavioral interview for this role.

skills.name: LinkedIn Optimizer
skills.description: Headline options, About section, and experience bullets rewritten for your target role.
skills.try_prompt: Improve my LinkedIn profile for product management roles.

skills.name: Networking Outreach
skills.description: Connection notes, coffee-chat requests, referral asks, and follow-ups people actually answer.
skills.try_prompt: Draft a coffee-chat request to a PM at Microsoft.

skills.name: Skill Creator
skills.description: Turn something you do often (case prep, meeting notes, study guides) into your own skill.

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.description: Better-looking web pages and app prototypes.

skills.name: Internal Comms
skills.description: Status updates, newsletters, and team announcements.

skills.name: Excel
skills.description: Build spreadsheets with formulas and charts.
